A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (5 April 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-lordmaul-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lord Maul (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “May not be Disarmed.” is removed; “May not be Disarmed.” is added after “with a lightsaber).”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
